title: UA Agro - Compliance
description: Section 15.1's compliance dashboard. Everything here is a legal boundary rather than a quality metric, so the panels are counts of violations, where the correct value is always zero, rather than rates where a small number looks acceptable.

panels.title: Calls outside the 09:00-21:00 IST window
panels.description: Section 18. The dialer enforces this at dial time; any non-zero value means that check was bypassed, and each occurrence is a violation per call.

panels.title: Promotional calls from a non-140 CLI
panels.description: Section 13.1. These connect perfectly and violate TCCCPR on every call, so nothing else in the system would notice.

panels.title: Audit chain verification
panels.description: Section 17: tamper-evident. 1 is intact; 0 is either corruption or someone editing history.

panels.title: Compliance gate: contacts removed by check
panels.description: Section 13.1's per-check breakdown, over time. A consent bar growing week on week is a consent-collection problem, and this is where it becomes visible before a campaign is blocked entirely.

panels.title: Opt-outs honoured
panels.description: Section 13.2 writes internal_dnc synchronously during the call. The two series should be identical; a gap means a write failed and somebody who asked to be removed is still on the list.

panels.title: Unapproved advisory rows
panels.description: Section 9. Not zero means the agent is currently refusing dosage questions and escalating, which is correct behaviour and an unusable service.

panels.title: Recordings past their retention date
panels.description: Section 18. The lifecycle rule should keep this at zero; a non-zero value means the rule is not running.

panels.title: Consent expiring within 14 days
panels.description: Section 18 makes consent non-permanent. This is the number that tells an operator to re-collect before a campaign silently loses half its audience.
